newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Wednesday, issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and they are annual percentage rates.
The central bank does not post volumes.
Traders said trading was active today with some state-owned banks lending out large amounts of money on the market.
The market rates have dropped sharply in the past few trading days after the central bank cut bank interest rates last Friday but traders said the news had now been digested.

"The rates are likely to consolidate in a narrow box in the short term," said one trader. "But in the mid-term, there are still factors to drive them down including a possible bank reserve ratio cut by the central bank."
